name: agent-plugins
description: Claude Code and Codex plugins for verifying Android changes and gating agent work behind an approved plan

plugins.name: android-verify
plugins.description: Verify Android changes on an emulator or device over plain adb — build identity check, a person signs in, scenario driven from uiautomator dumps, screenshots and backend responses in the report — and run Gradle with its output read through a summary instead of the raw log.

plugins.name: plan-gate
plugins.description: Plan, approve, execute, verify: the plan is written and shown first, nothing changes until a person approves it, an executor agent on a cheaper model carries it out, and the diff is checked against the plan before the report.
